messages:
Alex (PM): Quick quarterly check-in for OKR: Shipline stability milestone. TL;DR: Canary shipped, 2 regressions found, one deploy rollback, next steps + owners below. Please ack and drop short updates by EOD.

Maria (Eng): Ack. I'll post brief status.

Lee (Infra): Saw the canary alerts this morning, investigating autoscale variance.

Alex (PM): What shipped: canary routing rule + per-customer prefork. Feature PR: <https://git.redwood/shipline/pull/412>.

Maria (Eng): Shipped PR + rollout to 10% traffic. Regression 1: cold-start latency spike on 2k seq. Root cause - mem pressure from new cache eviction. Assigned to me and Lee.

Lee (Infra): Confirmed. Repro with load test: `wrk -c200 -d60s -t8 --latency http://canary.redwood` shows 95p latency jump. Fix candidate: bump KV cache limit and tweak GC window. I'll try a canary patch.

Sophie (Product Ops): Customer-facing note? A couple customers saw slower responses; we should queue a short status note. I'll draft.

Maria (Eng): Regression 2: test harness flake causing evals to time out. Lower severity. On my list after infra patch.

Alex (PM): Owners and next steps: 
- Maria (Eng): take ownership of cache tuning + PR for fix (target: tomorrow midday).
- Lee (Infra): run targeted canary with GC tweak and report metrics (target: today EOD).
- Sophie (Product Ops): publish status note if Lee sees ongoing impact (TBD).

Maria (Eng): Pinged in the PR with preliminary config: `cache.max_entries=1_200_000` and `gc.window_ms=50`. Draft PR link: <https://git.redwood/shipline/pull/418>. Asking for quick review.

Alex (PM): Code review pings: @Lee can you review #418? Also @Maria please add a short perf regression test to prevent reintroduction.

Lee (Infra): Reviewing now. Left small comment about telemetry tags. Will run canary with patched config in staging at 5pm PST.

Maria (Eng): noted, adding perf test. Small snippet of test plan in PR description.

DevOps Bot: deploybot: canary-deploy started for shipline v1.3.7 -> staging at 2026-03-18T17:00Z :rocket:

Lee (Infra): Staging canary results: latency back to baseline on 2k seq, throughput stable. Will try limited prod canary at 10% in 30m. Metrics: 95p = 220ms (prev spike 720ms).

Sophie (Product Ops): Drafted short note and queued for send if prod canary looks good.

Alex (PM): Thanks. If prod canary stable, plan: merge #418, promote canary to 50% and close this thread. If not, rollback plan ready (notify #oncall + start rollback).

Maria (Eng): On it. Will update PR and add the perf test by EOD.

Lee (Infra): Prod canary started. Monitoring dashboards: <https://metrics.redwood/shipline/canary>.

DevOps Bot: deploybot: canary traffic increased to 10% at 2026-03-18T17:45Z.

Alex (PM): One more ask: any dependent teams with blockers? e.g., evals team for regression 2.

Maria (Eng): Eval team (Sam) flagged flaky harness. I'll loop Sam in on the PR for test fixes.

Alex (PM): Great. If you have unresolved blockers by EOD, drop them here with owner/time. Otherwise we'll call this shipped for Qtr milestone and update OKR board. :white_check_mark:
